name: merge the pull request
command: gh pr comment <PR> --edit-last --body "$(sb plugin plans show <PLAN> --markdown)"
about: Land the branch. The PR is open and review has come back; this step is the act of merging it. Its exit condition is a gate: merging is a human's call unless they have said otherwise. Once merged and this step is ticked, update the plan comment `create-pr` left on the PR: this step's `command` is that update, and it edits that same comment in place rather than writing a new one, so the PR carries the state the plan ended in rather than the one it started from. Edit it, never add a second comment: two renderings of the same plan leave a reader working out which one is current.
